newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares weak as buyers watch new issues.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares weak as buyers watch new issues.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares continued weak on Wednesday as most investors waited on the sidelines for the outcome of new issues.
"Trade volumes are still thin and this is mainly a product of buyers staying out of the market until the new issues are over," one broker said.

The main industrial index lost a further 36.41 points to close at 10,070, pushed down largely by a 100 cent loss in bankers Barclays to 3,300 while pork producer Colcom shed 60 cents to 400 and hotel giant Meikles eased 50 cents to 2,500.
Other counters to lose included financial group Finhold, 40 cents down at 680, retailer Tedco which slipped 30 cents to 270 and window and door manufacturer Radar which put off 25 cents to 475.
Trade in minings picked up somewhat with nickel producer Bindura and coal miners Wankie trading unchanged while gold company Ashanti added 100 cents to 9,500 and Falgold edged up five cents to 70.
The seven-share mining index however lost 17.83 points to 969.89, largely on the back of gold mine Rio Tinto 's 100 cent loss to 2,500.
